# Copilot Instructions for `debian-qemu`

Use `AGENT.md` as the canonical source of project guidance.

## Required workflow for future sessions

1. Read `AGENT.md` first for build/test commands, architecture, and conventions.
2. When behavior or architecture changes, update `AGENT.md` in the same change.
3. Record new technical choices under `AGENT.md` -> **Decision log**.
